mainEntity.name: How long does a Webflow website take to build?

acceptedAnswer.text: Between 2 and 8 weeks, scope depending. A focused one-pager lands on the shorter end; a multilingual CMS build with custom animations lands on the longer one. Every project gets a proper quote after a 15-min scoping call — no templates, no guesswork.

mainEntity.name: Can you migrate my existing WordPress (or other) site to Webflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — WordPress, Squarespace, Wix, custom stacks. I handle the full migration: content, SEO equity (redirects, metadata, schema), CMS restructuring, and multilingual setup if needed. Your rankings stay intact, your site gets faster, and you stop fighting plugins.

mainEntity.name: What's actually included in your SEO / AEO service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Technical SEO (Core Web Vitals, indexing, internal linking), structured data engineering (Schema.org @graph, entity mapping), AEO optimization so AI engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity can cite you, keyword strategy, and on-page content work. Built into the website from day one — not bolted on later.

mainEntity.name: Do you design brand identities from scratch, or only websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. Full visual identity systems — logo, typography, color logic, usage rules — designed to scale across web, print, pitch decks, and social. Or I plug into your existing brand and extend it to the web without breaking it. Bigger logo ≠ better brand.
